human_scenarios.name: Install board, close lid and start device

success_criteria: Lid remains attached and no collision occurs

steps.instruction: Place the Raspberry Pi 5 on the selected set of four standoffs.
success_criteria: All four holes align; underside components do not contact unused standoffs

steps.instruction: Connect camera and power cables without strain.
success_criteria: Connectors fully seated and cable bend radius respected

steps.instruction: Close the lid and verify connector access.
success_criteria: Lid closes flush; all required ports accessible

steps.instruction: Power on and verify camera preview and telemetry.
success_criteria: Software starts; camera frames processed; no brownout warning

test_plans.name: Raspberry Pi 5 camera appliance verification plan

cases.name: Housing dimensional inspection
procedure: Generate 2D drawings from the approved revision.
Measure wall thickness and critical interfaces.
Compare measured values with approved parameters.

cases.name: FDM manufacturability check
procedure: Slice each STL with the selected printer profile.
Check non-manifold errors, supports, thin walls, travel and estimated material.
cases.notes: Adapter is a plug-in boundary in this package.

cases.name: Power and voltage-drop scenario
procedure: Run the lumped power model for every load case.
Flag current limit or brownout threshold violations.
Confirm estimates with bench measurements before release.
cases.notes: Analytical estimate, not SPICE or hardware-in-the-loop.

cases.name: Camera sample-image pipeline
procedure: Replay sample images through the containerized application.
Capture deterministic output metrics and logs.
cases.notes: Synthetic images are included; real camera validation is required.

cases.name: Human installation and misuse review
procedure: Record errors, ambiguity, forces, pinch points and recovery steps.
cases.notes: Digital-human ergonomics is a future adapter; current evaluation is rule/checklist based.
